description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_x_zero_flux_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D( k * D(u,x), x ) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior conservative flux-difference stencil aggregate; the two x-faces carrying the arithmetic-mean face conductivities and the free names), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
